text:
Avery: Heads up 999999999Found a few small but user-facing issues in the Console observability docs while prepping the migration guide:

1) SDK param rename: examples still use `kv_prefix` but SDK v1.14 renamed this to `kv_key_prefix`. Docs that show python/node snippets need a straight replace.

2) Dashboard JSON example: our sample `trace_to_cost` mapping includes `trace_context_id` which is now `trace_id` after the routing change. That also affects the TSV import snippet.

3) Playground preview link in the embed section is 404 (link-checker flagged it).

Priya: Thanks 999999999I can do the snippet updates for python and node. I'll open a tiny PR and include a short note: "requires SDK >= v1.14". Will also run the docs rendering step locally to confirm the fenced codeblocks keep indentation.

Kelsey: Re: playground links 999999999The preview host changed last quarter; we need to switch to `https://playground.redwood.ai/embed` and add a query param `?sample=console-cost` so it shows the right state. Happy to patch that in the same PR.

docs-bot: Link-checker: 1 broken link 999999999(confirmed) -> /playground/old-embed (line ~142).

Avery: Priya, can you also add a one-line clarification under "Cost breakdown" that we display cost per output token (USD) and include a tiny example: "100 tokens * $0.0005 = $0.05"? Keeps it concrete for readers.

Priya: Will do. Also noticed the docs site sometimes strips leading blank lines inside fenced blocks which breaks Python. Workaround: add a short plain-text line before the block and a comment line inside the block (e.g., `# snippet start`) to preserve indentation. I'll include a regression test in docs CI to render the page and assert the snippet contains the exact string `trace = TraceHook(kv_key_prefix="user:session:")`.

Kelsey: Good call on the CI test. Could you add a small Jest script or Python check? We already have a tiny harness under `scripts/snippet-tests`.

Priya: I'll add a PyTest that uses `mkdocs build` and `beautifulsoup4` to validate snippet text.

Luca: I'll review the PR tomorrow. One semantic question: when we say "cost per output token" do we mean tokens generated by the model only or including input tokens? For Console's default cost view it's output tokens only. Please spell that out briefly.

Avery: Yep output tokens only. Also add a note that unit prices are regional and link to the pricing page.

docs-bot: PR created: #8732 by priya/docs-fix-kvkey (checks running). Staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-8732 (expires in 6 days).

Priya: Pushed updates: replaced `kv_prefix` -> `kv_key_prefix`, changed `trace_context_id` -> `trace_id`, fixed playground URL, and added the CI snippet test. Running local mkdocs serve to sanity check.

Kelsey: Reviewing now. :eyes:

Avery: When you merge, please add a changelog note under "Docs" so customers see the SDK note. Also mention to SDK team that the rename caused breakage so they can consider a non-breaking shim in the next minor release.

Luca: LGTM overall. Will do a quick pass on wording and merge after tests.

Priya: Thanks all, will watch the build and ping if anything fails.
